cardiovascular_disease_and_stroke: Sparse current comorbidities with unknown chronology; excluded from deployment.
family_history: Sparse and unexpectedly inverse-associated; excluded from selected contract.
glucose: Random-session glucose is a concurrent diagnostic measurement and may have contributed to the physician-reviewed label; incorporation bias is unknown.
height_weight_bmi: BMI is derived from height/weight; all three are redundant.

hypertensive.risk: current diagnosis/history may postdate diabetes or proxy care intensity

known_diabetes: The ElderCareBD has_diabetes profile field is the target/history and must never be used as a predictor; known diabetes should bypass screening.

calibration.interpretation: Internal out-of-fold diagnostic only. The score is not externally calibrated for an individual Bangladeshi elder and must not be called the chance of disease.

row_order.warning: Strong row-order heterogeneity suggests hidden site/batch structure, but site/person/time identifiers are unavailable for grouped validation.

target_timing: Contemporaneous recorded diabetic status, not a future-onset endpoint. The diagnostic gold standard, diagnosis date, medication status, and temporal relationship to predictors are not documented.
